_comment: Tier-2 for skfem dg_methods#2, verified 2026-08-06 on skfem 12.0.1. Pure advection b=(1,0.5), f=0, inflow g=1, exact u==1. With the inflow load on FacetBasis (32 boundary facets) upwind DG reproduces u==1 to 2.2e-15; assembling the same load on InteriorFacetBasis (176 interior facets) leaves the matrix non-singular -- nothing warns -- but the solution runs to [-0.67, +16.9] and its streamwise band means become non-monotone.
